effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Attacks 8 enemies in a 60°, 6m cone in front of Syrenna, from a distance of 2m, dealing 67 damage. Casts a [1% Burn] debuff on the targets, lasting 6s. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.5% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK). 
Heals Syrenna, restoring (10% * Damage Dealt) HP.
Accuracy required for: Burn

bio: Syrenna was a fighter from the very beginning; she used to use sticks to protect her gentler sister, Arissa. All grown up, she still fights for her family – but now her blades are fire and steel, and her foes don’t live to try twice.
